reason: Verification failed at the complete stage due to execution issues and a catastrophic regression to a no-op CLI. With two iterations remaining, restoring a functional CLI with robust JSON I/O, local (non-Docker) execution, and a minimal simulation stub can recover passable functionality next iteration. Model accuracy improvements can follow once basic execution is stable.

specific_areas: Restore an executable CLI that reads JSON, runs locally by default, and prints valid JSON
Implement Docker detection and graceful fallback; add --use-docker/--no-docker flags
Add defensive JSON parsing with precise error diagnostics and stable exit codes (0 success, 2 JSON error, 3 Docker requested but missing)
Remove import-time execution; keep direct main() call but make it idempotent and add SKIP_AUTO_MAIN env guard
Reintroduce a minimal engine module with a local stub path; lazy-import optional deps (numpy, networkx)
Update/adjust smoke tests to avoid hard Docker requirement (default to local or pass --no-docker)
Ensure output schema stability (adoption_rate_over_time, peak_adoption_rate, endline_adoption)
Add basic unit tests for CLI JSON I/O, local execution path, and output schema
Provide README usage notes and requirements.txt (optional deps guarded)

data_analysis.adjustments: No change for next iteration; focus is on restoring execution. Defer calibration/data alignment to the following iteration if time permits.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Validate output schema and numeric ranges; ensure time series length matches requested days. Include basic sanity checks and log warnings instead of failing hard when possible.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Emit clear, actionable error messages for JSON parsing and Docker unavailability, including line/column/char positions for JSON errors and guidance to run with --no-docker.
